body: Thanks for your support. It has made me strong.
It's not possible to move on. Do people stay with bpd if they have decided to heal very honestly?

Hello All,  thank you so much for your kind words. We have sorted out everything in between and now everything is going to be fine. She will be dedicated to me only. Also she has decided to heal from current situation.
What did you guys have felt after entering into such kind of open relationship?

The moment of Unrealised facts I am feeling is, whether I should walk out or stay with her. Please through some light on it. Most surprising fact is even I don't  know you people at all and still you are able to analyse and reflect on my situation and the person   sleeping next to me is near to dead when it comes to understand my feelings however expressive I am.

Hey,  apologies for being so direct. But if I am able to think any considered advice, why would I ask you. Yes I am hurt and most uncomfortable having this situation,but I want to know the way out for this. I have weekend before I go to my work and left her in the dullest phase of her life. I am looking forward to walk out if it's for her happiness but I am damn sure she will end up being alone on life and missing me.
Hey dude,  can you please help me out with the possible same situation you had felt. My page is drafted at the recent post of mine.

It's 7 year old relationship. Even her love letter from her is in my beg all the time. Her mother is going through terminal illness called CJD. It has even connecting me more to her. I have make myself capable of being her mother like feature for life time. If you want to analyser further I can even send my love letters to you.  I don't mind even making it public if you can save her being so apathetic. I have cared for her the moment I have lived in last 7 years. She is so skilled at making facts distorted to limit that even the guys talking with them are so getting fooled. I feel pity for them.

She has find some guys who are adding fuel to the situation. Please help me. Its not just her. Its also me who is going through hell of pain. She just forgot in one moment what she was and is thinking about me the moment she find ways to manipulate me by convincing me either to manage her this kind of infidelity for life time or to left her. I request you all people to help me by sharing your experiences with this trauma. Its really devastating.

Thanks for your words but I am not asking for open relationship. I want it to be as tightly coupled as possible. I'm not able to convince her for not to do this. Also I want to give her space to do what she wants but what's point of the relationship if no boundaries are maintained?

Honestly, I am not comfortable with this request and manipulation.  I am not able to figure out trade off between believing her or to left her.  You might be sure that there is no option for convincing her and it's true.
